descriptionChirho: The proper name Shimei/Shimi, referring to several individuals in the Hebrew Bible, most notably Shimei son of Gera who cursed David (2 Samuel 16), as well as Levites and officials in Chronicles and Kings. All four clusters are grammatical and prepositional variants of the same name. Spanish Simei/Shimei/Shimi, Arabic Shimii, Hindi Shimii/ShimI, Korean simeuiga/simeiiga, Swahili Shimei. The fourth cluster (S142325) appears to be a ketiv/qere variant but still the same person/name. All languages use a consistent transliteration across clusters.
